title: Flatness over a localized polynomial ring whose variables give a basis of the differentials of a residue subfield
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ and $(A,\mathfrak m,K)$ a Noetherian local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Let $k\subseteq F\subseteq K$ be a subfield which is finitely generated as a field extension of $k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $\varphi:k[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to A$ be a homomorphism of $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that the image of each $y_i$ in $K$ lies in $F$ and such that $\mathrm dy_1,\dots,\mathrm dy_m$ map to a basis of the $F$-vector space $\Omega_{F/k}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] (that is, the elements $\mathrm d(\bar\varphi(y_i))$, $\bar\varphi(y_i)$ the residue class of $\varphi(y_i)$, form a basis). Set $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak m)$. Then the induced map $k[y_1,\dots,y_m]_{\mathfrak p}\to A$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $A/\mathfrak pA$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].

proof.text: Construct ψ by IsLocalization.lift: every s outside p maps to a unit. The lift_comp equation gives its restriction. Represent a localization element by r/s; a unit image implies φ(r) is a unit, so r lies outside p. The AtPrime unit criterion proves ψ is local. The polynomial regular-ring Mathlib instance gives regularity of A_0; Proposition 07E5 gives regularity of A.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-differential-coordinates-cotangent-independent to preserve cotangent independence. The proved private helper extend_parameters_of_cotangent_independence chooses a cotangent basis of m_0 lifted to a finite set s; Nakayama makes s generate m_0 and its cardinality is dim A_0. Its ψ-image is independent in the target cotangent space. Extend that independent set to a basis b and lift the remaining vectors to a list y. Enumerate s first as x, then b minus its image: x.map ψ ++ y generates m_A by Nakayama, and its length is dim A. All set/image cardinality and ordered-list identities are proved in Lean.

Apply isRegular_and_quotients_of_generators to x.map ψ ++ y. Weak regularity of its prefix x.map ψ follows from isWeaklyRegular_append_iff; its elements lie in m_A, so the local Nakayama regularity criterion makes the prefix regular. flat_of_regular_parameters then proves ψ.Flat. The same initial-quotient theorem proves regular locality of the quotient by the prefix.

Use the restriction equation and map_map to identify p.map φ with (maximalIdeal A_0).map ψ. Rewrite the maximal ideal as Ideal.ofList x and use map_ofList. The prefix of x.map ψ ++ y of length x.length is x.map ψ, so the ideal is exactly the ideal in the quotient conclusion. Rewrite the proved regularity of that quotient, and supply ψ with its restriction and flatness proofs.
